';
window.HOJA_V051_FIT_INFO=()=>{
 const el=document.getElementById('hcUnitInfoName');if(!el||!el.getBoundingClientRect().width)return;
 const raw=String(el.dataset.fullTitle||el.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
 if(el.dataset.fullTitle!==raw)el.dataset.fullTitle=raw;
 const words=raw.split(' '),ctx=document.createElement('canvas').getContext('2d');if(!ctx)return;
 const style=getComputedStyle(el),width=el.clientWidth-6,weight=style.fontWeight||'900',family=style.fontFamily||'sans-serif';
 const measure=(line,size)=>{ctx.font=weight+' '+size+'px '+family;return ctx.measureText(line).width};
 const candidates=[];
 for(let sz=48;sz>=20;sz--){
  if(measure(raw,sz)<=width&&words.length<6){candidates.push({lines:[raw],sz,score:(48-sz)*.5});}
  for(let cut=1;cut<words.length;cut++){
   const lines=[words.slice(0,cut).join(' '),words.slice(cut).join(' ')];
   const w=lines.map(x=>measure(x,sz));if(Math.max(...w)>width)continue;
   const balance=Math.abs(w[0]-w[1])/Math.max(...w);
   candidates.push({lines,sz,score:balance*90+(48-sz)*.75});
  }
 }
 candidates.sort((a,b)=>a.score-b.score);const best=candidates[0];
 if(best){el.textContent=best.lines.join('\n');el.style.whiteSpace='pre-line';el.style.overflowWrap='normal';el.style.wordBreak='keep-all';el.style.fontSize=best.sz+'px';}
};
window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(!document.getElementById('hcUnitInfoPanel').hidden)window.HOJA_V051_FIT_INFO();},{passive:true});
window.HOJA_GAMEPLAY=(()=>{
 const host=()=>document.getElementById('hojaGamePlay');
 const frame=()=>document.getElementById('hqArcadeFrame');
 const stage=()=>document.getElementById('hqStage');
 const canvas=()=>document.getElementById('hqBg');
 const img=id=>document.getElementById(id);
 const SEASONS={
  spring:{sky:'#50bbff',ground:'#885a45',family:0,bg:['sgSky','sgCloud1','sgCloud2','sgHills','sgForeground']},
  summer:{sky:'#50bbff',ground:'#b27c57',family:0,bg:['thTroSky','thTroCloudsBG','thTroClouds','thTroWaters']},
  autumn:{sky:'#fff3d8',ground:'#743e45',family:4,bg:['thAutDistant','thAutRow2','thAutRow1','thAutPiles','thAutTrees','thAutLeafTop']},
  winter:{sky:'#fff8ff',ground:'#a66567',family:8,bg:['thWinMountain','thWinHills','thWinFore']}
 };
 let questions=[];
 function setServerQuestions(sources){
  const familyMap=new Map(), sourceNames=new Set();
  if(!Array.isArray(sources)||sources.length<1||sources.length>5)throw new Error('서버 카트리지 개수 오류');
  for(const entry of sources){
   if(!entry||!entry.data||entry.data.questionSchemaVersion!==2||![1,2].includes(entry.data.sourceSheetVersion)||!Array.isArray(entry.data.questions))throw new Error('서버 문제 스키마 오류');
   if(sourceNames.has(entry.sheetName))throw new Error('중복 카트리지');sourceNames.add(entry.sheetName);
   for(const r of entry.data.questions){
    if(r?.isNull===true||!String(r?.familyId||'').trim()||!String(r?.question||'').trim())throw new Error('문제 묶음 ID/내용 오류');
    if(!['OX','MULTIPLE','SUBJECTIVE'].includes(r.type))throw new Error('알 수 없는 유형');
    if(r.type==='SUBJECTIVE')continue;
    const key=entry.sheetName+'::'+String(r.familyId);
    let family=familyMap.get(key);
    if(!family){family={key,variants:[]};familyMap.set(key,family);}
    if(family.variants.some(x=>x.sourceType===r.type))throw new Error('중복 문제 유형');
    let choices;
    if(r.type==='OX'){
     if(!['O','X'].includes(r.answer))throw new Error('OX 정답 오류');
     choices=[{text:'O',correct:r.answer==='O'},{text:'X',correct:r.answer==='X'}];
    }else{
     if(!Array.isArray(r.options)||r.options.length!==4||!['1','2','3','4'].includes(String(r.answer)))throw new Error('객관식 데이터 오류');
     const ix=Number(r.answer)-1;
     if(r.options.some(v=>!String(v||'').trim())||new Set(r.options.map(v=>String(v).trim())).size!==4)throw new Error('객관식 보기 오류');
     const wrong=r.options.map((text,i)=>({text:String(text).trim(),correct:false,i})).filter(x=>x.i!==ix);
     for(let i=wrong.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[wrong[i],wrong[j]]=[wrong[j],wrong[i]];}
     choices=[{text:String(r.options[ix]).trim(),correct:true},...wrong.slice(0,2)];
    }
    for(let i=choices.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[choices[i],choices[j]]=[choices[j],choices[i]];}
    family.variants.push({sourceType:r.type,type:r.type==='OX'?'OX':'MC',q:r.question,choices:choices.map(x=>x.text),answer:choices.findIndex(x=>x.correct)});
   }
  }
  if(!familyMap.size)throw new Error('이 카트리지에는 객관식 또는 OX 문제가 없습니다.');
  // Project B may give BOTH OX and MULTIPLE rows for a family. The older
  // first-row-wins logic discarded every later MULTIPLE variant when OX came first.
  // Retain one question per family, while choosing a balanced available type.
  const families=[...familyMap.values()];
  const fixedOX=families.filter(x=>x.variants.length===1&&x.variants[0].type==='OX');
  const fixedMC=families.filter(x=>x.variants.length===1&&x.variants[0].type==='MC');
  const flexible=families.filter(x=>x.variants.length>1);
  for(let i=flexible.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[flexible[i],flexible[j]]=[flexible[j],flexible[i]];}
  const wantMC=Math.max(0,Math.min(flexible.length,Math.round(families.length/2)-fixedMC.length));
  const picked=[...fixedOX,...fixedMC].map(f=>f.variants[0]);
  flexible.forEach((f,i)=>{
   const type=i<wantMC?'MC':'OX';
   const option=f.variants.find(q=>q.type===type)||f.variants[0];
   picked.push(option);
  });
  for(let i=picked.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[picked[i],picked[j]]=[picked[j],picked[i]];}
  questions=picked;
 }

 // Actual 32x32 source frame strips: 2 / 2 / 2 / 3 / 4 frames.
 // Cache once, then switch only the displayed image at each animation beat.
 const ENEMY_FRAME_SOURCES={
  jumpy:{source:'enJumpyIdle',fps:3,frames:2},
  hermie:{source:'enHermieCrawl',fps:3,frames:2},
  roach:{source:'enRoachRun',fps:4,frames:2},
  owl:{source:'enOwlFly',fps:6,frames:3},
  ghost:{source:'enBlankeyFloat',fps:3,frames:4}
 };
 const enemyFrameCache=new Map();let enemyFrameTimer=0;
 function prepareEnemyFrames(){
  Object.entries(ENEMY_FRAME_SOURCES).forEach(([kind,spec])=>{
   if(enemyFrameCache.has(kind))return;
   const sheet=img(spec.source);
   if(!sheet?.complete||sheet.naturalWidth<32*spec.frames)return;
   const tile=document.createElement('canvas');tile.width=tile.height=32;
   const ctx=tile.getContext('2d',{alpha:true});ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
   const frames=[];
   for(let index=0;index<spec.frames;index++){
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,32,32);
    ctx.drawImage(sheet,index*32,0,32,32,0,0,32,32);
    frames.push(tile.toDataURL('image/png'));
   }
   enemyFrameCache.set(kind,frames);
  });
 }
 function tickEnemyFrames(){
  if(page!=='quiz'||host().hidden||document.hidden)return;
  prepareEnemyFrames();
  const t=performance.now();
  stage().querySelectorAll('.hqEnemy').forEach(enemy=>{
   const kind=enemy.dataset.enemy,spec=ENEMY_FRAME_SOURCES[kind],frames=enemyFrameCache.get(kind);
   if(!spec||!frames?.length)return;
   const speed=enemy.classList.contains('hqCelebrate')?2.4:1;
   const index=Math.floor(t*spec.fps*speed/1000)%frames.length;
   if(enemy.dataset.spriteFrame===kind+':'+index)return;
   enemy.querySelector('img:first-child').src=frames[index];
   enemy.dataset.spriteFrame=kind+':'+index;
  });
 }
 function startEnemyFrames(){
  if(enemyFrameTimer)clearInterval(enemyFrameTimer);
  enemyFrameTimer=setInterval(tickEnemyFrames,80);tickEnemyFrames();
 }
 function stopEnemyFrames(){if(enemyFrameTimer){clearInterval(enemyFrameTimer);enemyFrameTimer=0;}}
 function clearServerQuestions(){questions=[];}
 let page='',season='spring',jumping=false,activeQuiz=false,answered=0,correct=0,deck=[],anim=0,questionHandler=null,doneTimer=0,loadId=0,original='',resumeIntroAudio=false,finished=false,lastCorrect=false;
 const updateQuizHud=()=>{img('hqHudTotal').textContent=questions.length+'종';img('hqHudAnswered').textContent=String(answered);img('hqHudCorrect').textContent=String(correct);};
 const player=()=>img('hqCharacter');
 function sprite(name){const fr=(typeof RAW_GROUPS!=='undefined'?RAW_GROUPS[name]:[])?.[0];return fr?makeHojaCanvas(fr).toDataURL('image/png'):img('hojaModeWalk')?.src;}
 let idle='',jump='';
 function nextQuestion(){if(!deck.length)return null;return questions[deck.pop()];} function placeBalloon(){
  // Source 64x64 HOJA at INTEGER 2x (128px); sprite contact aligned to G=425/540.
  // Source 32x32 balloon at INTEGER 2x (64px); keep jumping collision gap stable.
  const h=stage().clientHeight,ph=player().getBoundingClientRect().height;
  const groundFromBottom=h*(1-425/540);
  const gap=Math.max(18,Math.min(36,h*.055));
  img('hqBalloon').style.bottom=Math.round(groundFromBottom+ph+gap)+'px';player().style.bottom=Math.round(groundFromBottom-(player().getBoundingClientRect().height*3/64))+'px';
}
 function drawBackground(){
  const c=canvas();if(!c)return;const ctx=c.getContext('2d');const w=c.width,h=c.height,G=425;
  const t=SEASONS[season]||SEASONS.spring;ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;ctx.fillStyle=t.sky;ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
  t.bg.forEach(name=>{const im=img(name);if(!im?.naturalWidth)return;const ww=im.naturalWidth*2,hh=im.naturalHeight*2,y=G-hh+20;
    for(let x=0;x<w;x+=ww)ctx.drawImage(im,x,y,ww,hh);
  });
  const terrain=img('paV2Terrain');ctx.fillStyle=t.ground;ctx.fillRect(0,G,w,h-G);
  if(terrain?.naturalWidth)for(let x=0;x<w;x+=32){ctx.drawImage(terrain,112,t.family*16,16,16,x,G,32,32);for(let y=G+32;y<h;y+=32)ctx.drawImage(terrain,112,(t.family+1)*16,16,16,x,y,32,32)}
 }

  async function expandArcade(){
   if(original)return original;
   if(!('DecompressionStream' in window))throw new Error('이 브라우저는 아케이드 압축 해제를 지원하지 않습니다. 최신 Chrome을 사용하세요.');
   const raw=atob(HOJA_V051_ARCADE_GZIP), bytes=Uint8Array.from(raw,c=>c.charCodeAt(0));
   const decoded=await new Response(new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('gzip'))).text();
   const portraitNode=document.getElementById('hojaTeamR10PortraitAssets');
   if(!portraitNode)throw new Error('HOJA R17D 팀전 공용 감정 JSON 누락');
   const portraits=JSON.parse(portraitNode.textContent);
   const types={HOJA:'HOJA',NAHANSANG:'NAHANSANG'};
   const emotions=['01_NEUTRAL','02_SURPRISED','03_ANGRY','04_TIRED','05_SHY','06_SAD','07_SLEEPY','08_EMBARRASSED','09_SPARKLING','10_CURIOUS'];
   const ptrToken=/__HOJA_R17D_PORTRAIT_(HOJA|NAHANSANG)_(\d{2})__/g;
   let ptrUsed=0,domUsed=0;
   const withPortraits=decoded.replace(ptrToken,(token,ch,idx)=>{
    const slot=Number(idx),emo=emotions[slot];
    const uri=emo&&portraits.characters?.[types[ch]]?.emotions?.[emo]?.imageData;
    if(!uri||!uri.startsWith('data:image/webp;base64,'))throw new Error('R17D 공용 감정 일러스트 누락: '+token);
    ptrUsed++;return uri;
   });
   const restored=withPortraits.replace(/__HOJA_R17D_SHARED_(\d{2})__/g,(token,index)=>{
    const def=HOJA_R17D_SHARED_DOM[Number(index)];
    if(!def)throw new Error('R17D 공유 에셋 매핑 누락: '+token);
    const uri=document.getElementById(def[0])?.getAttribute('src')||'';
    if(!uri.startsWith('data:')||!uri.includes(';base64,'))throw new Error('R17D 공유 에셋 누락: '+token);
    domUsed++;return uri;
   });
   if(ptrUsed!==20 || domUsed!==44 || restored.includes('__HOJA_R17D_'))
     throw new Error('R17D 아케이드 에셋 복원 검증 실패');
   original=restored;
   return original;
  }
 async function launch(which,requested){
  if(!window.HOJA_B_LIVE?.sources||!questions.length){window.alert('Project B 문제를 먼저 선택하고 불러와야 합니다.');return;}
  stop();const own=++loadId;page=which;season=SEASONS[requested]?requested:window.HOJA_SEASON_SESSION?.current?.()||'spring';
  window.HOJA_MODE_PREVIEW?.hide?.();host().hidden=false;
  host().dataset.mode=which;frame().hidden=which!=='arcade';stage().hidden=which!=='quiz';
  img('hqArcadeInfo').hidden=true;img('hqHud').hidden=which!=='quiz';img('hqModeLabel').textContent=which==='arcade'?'아케이드 모드 · 호자 모험':'문제 풀이 모드 · Project B 문제';
  if(which==='arcade'){
   if(new Set(window.HOJA_B_LIVE.sources.flatMap(e=>e.data.questions.filter(q=>q.type==='OX'||q.type==='MULTIPLE').map(q=>e.sheetName+'::'+q.familyId))).size<25){img('hqArcadeInfo').hidden=false;img('hqArcadeInfo').textContent='아케이드는 고유 문제 묶음 25개 이상이 필요합니다. 다른 단원을 추가로 선택해 주세요.';return;}
   window.HOJA_AUDIO_CONTROL?.syncArcade?.();
   try{
    const restored=(await expandArcade()).replace('__HOJA_ARCADE_SEASON__',season);
    if(!restored.includes('</head>'))throw new Error('아케이드 HUD 템플릿 확인 실패');
    const src=restored.replace('</head>',
      '<style id="hojaR17GInnerHudOff">#hojaArcadeSharedControls{display:none!important;visibility:hidden!important;pointer-events:none!important}</style></head>');
    if(own!==loadId)return;const f=frame();f.srcdoc=src;window.HOJA_V055_WATCH_ARCADE?.(f);f.addEventListener('load',()=>{window.HOJA_AUDIO_CONTROL?.syncArcade?.();window.HOJA_V055_BIND_ARCADE?.(f)},{once:true});
   }catch(err){if(own!==loadId)return;img('hqArcadeInfo').hidden=false;img('hqArcadeInfo').textContent='아케이드 실행 준비 실패: '+err.message;}
  }else{
   answered=0;correct=0;deck=questions.map((_,i)=>i);for(let i=deck.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[deck[i],deck[j]]=[deck[j],deck[i]];}activeQuiz=false;jumping=false;finished=false;lastCorrect=false;stage().dataset.quizFinished='false';img('hqResult').hidden=true;
   img('hqOverlay').hidden=true;updateQuizHud();
   idle=sprite('IDLE');jump=sprite('JUMP');player().src=idle||img('hojaModeWalk')?.src;
   player().style.transform='translateX(-50%) translateY(0px)';img('hqBalloon').hidden=false;placeBalloon();drawBackground();startEnemyFrames();
  }
 }
 function stop(){
  stopEnemyFrames();
  loadId++;if(anim){cancelAnimationFrame(anim);anim=0;}
  if(doneTimer){clearTimeout(doneTimer);doneTimer=0;}
  if(questionHandler){window.removeEventListener('keydown',questionHandler,true);questionHandler=null;}
  activeQuiz=false;jumping=false;img('hqOverlay').hidden=true;img('hqResult').hidden=true;
  frame().removeAttribute('srcdoc');frame().removeAttribute('src');frame().hidden=true;
 }
 function back(){stop();page='';host().hidden=true;window.HOJA_MODE_PREVIEW.show(season);window.HOJA_AUDIO_CONTROL?.render?.();}
 function collide(){const p=player().getBoundingClientRect(),b=img('hqBalloon').getBoundingClientRect();return p.top<b.bottom-4&&p.bottom>b.top+10&&p.left<b.right&&p.right>b.left;}
 function triggerJump(){
  if(page!=='quiz'||activeQuiz||jumping||finished||host().hidden)return;
  window.HOJA_INTRO_AUDIO?.play?.('hop',.65,1,0);
  jumping=true;player().src=jump||idle;
  const t0=performance.now(),duration=800,amplitude=Math.min(stage().clientHeight*.25,125);
  function tick(now){
   if(page!=='quiz'){jumping=false;return;}
   const t=Math.min(1,(now-t0)/duration),height=4*amplitude*t*(1-t);
   player().style.transform='translateX(-50%) translateY(-'+height.toFixed(1)+'px)';
   if(t<.75&&collide()){
    jumping=false;player().style.transform='translateX(-50%) translateY(0px)';player().src=idle;
    openQuestion();return;
   }
   if(t<1){anim=requestAnimationFrame(tick)}else{jumping=false;player().src=idle;player().style.transform='translateX(-50%) translateY(0px)';}
  }
  anim=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
 }
 function closeQuestion(){
  img('hqOverlay').hidden=true;activeQuiz=false;if(questionHandler){window.removeEventListener('keydown',questionHandler,true);questionHandler=null;}
  const justCorrect=lastCorrect;lastCorrect=false;
  if(justCorrect)celebrate();
  if(answered>=questions.length){
   if(justCorrect){const epoch=loadId;window.setTimeout(()=>{if(page==='quiz'&&loadId===epoch)showQuizResults()},1350);}
   else showQuizResults();return;
  }
  img('hqBalloon').hidden=false;
 }
 function showQuizResults(){
  finished=true;stage().dataset.quizFinished='true';img('hqBalloon').hidden=true;
  img('hqResultAnswered').textContent=String(answered);img('hqResultCorrect').textContent=String(correct);
  img('hqResultPercent').textContent=String(Math.round(correct*100/Math.max(1,answered)))+'%';
  img('hqResult').hidden=false;window.HOJA_INTRO_AUDIO?.play?.('clear',.7,1,0);
 }
 function celebrate(){
  document.querySelectorAll('#hqStage .hqEnemy').forEach((en,i)=>{
   en.classList.remove('hqCelebrate');void en.offsetWidth;
   window.setTimeout(()=>en.classList.add('hqCelebrate'),i*65);
   window.setTimeout(()=>en.classList.remove('hqCelebrate'),2000);
  });
 }
 function popBalloon(){
  const b=img('hqBalloon').getBoundingClientRect(),s=stage().getBoundingClientRect(),fx=img('hqBalloonBurst');
  fx.style.left=(b.left+b.width/2-s.left)+'px';fx.style.top=(b.top+b.height*.43-s.top)+'px';fx.replaceChildren();
  for(let i=0;i<13;i++){const part=document.createElement('i');part.className='hqBurstPix';
   const a=2*Math.PI*i/13;part.style.setProperty('--x',Math.round(Math.cos(a)*(27+i%3*10))+'px');
   part.style.setProperty('--y',Math.round(Math.sin(a)*(27+i%3*10))+'px');
   if(i%3===0)part.style.background='#fff9bf';fx.append(part);}
  window.HOJA_INTRO_AUDIO?.play?.('collect',.75,1,0);
 }
 function openQuestion(){
  if(page!=='quiz'||activeQuiz)return;
  if(finished)return;const q=nextQuestion();if(!q){showQuizResults();return;}activeQuiz=true;popBalloon();img('hqBalloon').hidden=true;const overlay=img('hqOverlay'),card=img('hqCard'),choices=img('hqChoices'),feedback=img('hqFeedback');
  card.dataset.quizKind=q.type==='OX'?'OX':'MC';img('hqType').textContent=q.type==='OX'?'O / X':'객관식';img('hqQuestion').textContent=q.q;
  choices.replaceChildren();feedback.textContent='';overlay.hidden=false;
  let locked=false,focus=-1;
  function choose(i){
   if(locked||i<0||i>=q.choices.length)return;locked=true;answered++;
   for(let k=0;k<choices.children.length;k++)if(k===q.answer)choices.children[k].classList.add('correct');
   if(i===q.answer){correct++;feedback.textContent='정답!  +10';window.HOJA_V055_SFX?.('correct');lastCorrect=true;}else{choices.children[i].classList.add('wrong');feedback.textContent='오답 · 0점';window.HOJA_V055_SFX?.('wrong');lastCorrect=false;}
   updateQuizHud();
   if(questionHandler){window.removeEventListener('keydown',questionHandler,true);questionHandler=null;}
   doneTimer=setTimeout(()=>{doneTimer=0;if(page==='quiz')closeQuestion()},950);
  }
  q.choices.forEach((text,i)=>{const btn=document.createElement('button');btn.type='button';btn.className='hqChoice';btn.dataset.answer=q.type==='OX'?text:'';
   const num=document.createElement('span');num.className='hqChoiceNumber';num.textContent=(i+1)+'.';const label=document.createElement('span');label.className='hqChoiceLabel';label.textContent=text;
   btn.append(num,label);btn.addEventListener('click',()=>choose(i));choices.append(btn);
  });
  const opened=performance.now();questionHandler=e=>{
   if(page!=='quiz'||!activeQuiz)return;
   const maps={Digit1:0,Digit2:1,Digit3:2,Numpad1:0,Numpad2:1,Numpad3:2,KeyO:0,KeyX:1};
   if(!(e.code in maps)&&!['ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','Enter','Space'].includes(e.code))return;
   e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();if(e.repeat||performance.now()-opened<250)return;
   if(e.code in maps){if(q.type==='OX'&&e.code==='KeyO')choose(q.choices.indexOf('O'));else if(q.type==='OX'&&e.code==='KeyX')choose(q.choices.indexOf('X'));else choose(maps[e.code]);return;}
   if(e.code.startsWith('Arrow')){focus=(focus+1)%q.choices.length;[...choices.children].forEach((b,k)=>b.classList.toggle('focus',k===focus));return;}
   if(focus>=0)choose(focus);else{focus=0;choices.children[0].classList.add('focus');}
  };
  window.addEventListener('keydown',questionHandler,true);
 }
 img('hqBalloon').addEventListener('click',triggerJump);
 img('hqPlayBack').addEventListener('click',back);
 img('hqResultRetry').addEventListener('click',()=>launch('quiz',season));
 img('hqResultBack').addEventListener('click',back);
 window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(page!=='quiz'||host().hidden||activeQuiz)return;
  if(e.code==='Space'){e.preventDefault();triggerJump();}
 },true);
 window.addEventListener('message',e=>{if(e.source===frame().contentWindow&&e.data?.type==='HOJA_V051_ARCADE_EXIT'&&page==='arcade')back();});
 window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(page==='quiz'&&!host().hidden){placeBalloon();drawBackground();}},{passive:true});
 return {launch,back,stop,setServerQuestions,clearServerQuestions,getCanonicalArcade:expandArcade,get state(){return {page,season,answered,correct,activeQuiz,jumping}}};
})();

</script><audio id="hqSfx_correct" src="data:audio/mpeg;base64," preload="none" aria-hidden="true"></audio>
<audio id="hqSfx_wrong" src="data:audio/mpeg;base64," preload="none" aria-hidden="true"></audio><script id="hojaV055QuizSfx">
window.HOJA_V055_SFX=(name)=>{
 if(!window.HOJA_AUDIO_CONTROL?.sfxOn)return;
 const source=document.getElementById('hqSfx_'+name);if(!source)return;
 const sound=source.cloneNode(true);sound.volume=.65;
 sound.play().catch(()=>{});sound.addEventListener('ended',()=>sound.remove(),{once:true});
};
</script>
<script id="hojaV055ArcadeParentBinder">
window.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{if(event.code==='F9'&&window.HOJA_GAMEPLAY?.state?.page==='arcade'){event.preventDefault();document.getElementById('hqArcadeFrame')?.contentWindow?.postMessage({kind:'HOJA_V063_PERF_TOGGLE'},'*');}},{capture:true});
window.HOJA_V055_BIND_ARCADE=(frame)=>{
 try{
  const doc=frame?.contentDocument, c=window.HOJA_AUDIO_CONTROL;
  if(!doc||!c)return;
  const back=doc.getElementById('hojaArcadeBack'),music=doc.getElementById('hojaArcadeMusic'),sfx=doc.getElementById('hojaArcadeSfx');
  if(!back||!music||!sfx)return;
  const sync=()=>{music.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(c.musicOn));sfx.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(c.sfxOn))};
  back.onclick=(ev)=>{ev.stopPropagation();window.HOJA_GAMEPLAY?.back?.()};
  music.onclick=(ev)=>{ev.stopPropagation();c.toggleMusic();sync()};
  sfx.onclick=(ev)=>{ev.stopPropagation();c.toggleSfx();sync()};
  doc.getElementById('hojaArcadeSharedControls').dataset.ready='true';sync();
 }catch(err){console.warn('V055 arcade HUD bind failed',err)}
};
window.HOJA_V055_WATCH_ARCADE=(frame)=>{
 let attempts=0;
 const poll=()=>{
  if(frame?.contentDocument?.getElementById('hojaArcadeBack')){window.HOJA_V055_BIND_ARCADE(frame);return;}
  if(++attempts<180)window.requestAnimationFrame(poll);
 };
 window.requestAnimationFrame(poll);
};

@keyframes htFlameSpin{from{transform:rotate(0deg)}to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}@keyframes htBorderFlicker{0%,100%{opacity:1;filter:brightness(1)}50%{opacity:.8;filter:brightness(1.22)}}

@keyframes htScoreGain{0%{transform:scale(1)}16%{transform:scale(1.12) rotate(-2deg)}34%{transform:scale(1.03) rotate(1.8deg)}54%{transform:scale(1.09) rotate(-1.2deg)}74%{transform:scale(1.02) rotate(.8deg)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}
@keyframes htScoreLoss{0%{transform:scale(1)}16%{transform:scale(.9) rotate(2deg)}34%{transform:scale(.98) rotate(-2.2deg)}54%{transform:scale(.92) rotate(1.4deg)}74%{transform:scale(.98) rotate(-.8deg)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}
@keyframes htSprite{from{background-position:0 0}to{background-position:100% 0}}@keyframes htEnemyWiggle{0%{transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}50%{transform:translateY(-6px) rotate(-4deg) scale(1.05)}100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(4deg) scale(1)}}@keyframes htFruitBob{0%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-5deg) scale(1)}50%{transform:translateY(-10px) rotate(0deg) scale(1.08)}100%{transform:translateY(-2px) rotate(5deg) scale(1)}}
@media(max-width:980px){#htTeamBoard{grid-template-columns:minmax(106px,1fr) minmax(0,4.5fr) minmax(106px,1fr);gap:8px}.htTeamScore{min-height:72px;padding:9px 10px}.htTeamName{font-size:14px}.htTeamPts{font-size:24px}.htBalloonGrid{width:min(100%,calc(100vh - 175px));padding:8px;gap:5px;border-radius:15px}.htBalloon .htBalloonNumber{font-size:clamp(14px,3.5vw,26px)}}
@media(max-width:750px){#htTeamBoard{inset:4px;gap:4px;grid-template-columns:minmax(74px,1fr) minmax(0,4.3fr) minmax(74px,1fr)}.htTeamScore{min-height:54px;padding:4px 5px;border-width:2px;border-radius:9px}.htTeamName{font-size:10px}.htTeamPts{font-size:15px}.htBalloonGrid{padding:4px;gap:3px;border-width:2px;border-radius:9px;width:min(100%,calc(100vh - 150px))}.htBalloon .htBalloonNumber{font-size:clamp(11px,3.2vw,19px);text-shadow:1px 1px #2a2436}.htModalCard{width:100%;border-width:2px}.htPipeBtn img{width:min(17vw,75px);height:min(17vw,75px)}#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #hqCard{min-height:min(640px,84vh)}#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #hqQuestion{font-size:clamp(22px,4.4vw,34px)!important}.htAction{font-size:14px;padding:10px 12px}}
#htTeamBoard[hidden]{display:none!important}
</style>
<style id="hojaTeamV067R5Fixes">
/* R5 integration: Project A v1.00.118 perimeter spark, color inverse, tail-less original balloon. */
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #hqStage{position:relative;background:#4babe1!important}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #htThemeBg{position:absolute!important;inset:0!important;width:100%!important;height:100%!important;z-index:1!important;overflow:hidden!important;pointer-events:none;border-radius:0!important;opacity:1!important}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #htThemeBg img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;image-rendering:pixelated}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #htThemeBg::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:6;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(5,26,43,.08),rgba(5,26,43,.28));pointer-events:none}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #htTeamBoard{z-index:7!important;inset:5px 10px 7px!important;grid-template-columns:minmax(132px,1.28fr) minmax(0,4.8fr) minmax(132px,1.28fr)!important;gap:clamp(6px,1.1vw,16px)!important}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htBoardCenter{min-width:0;min-height:0;display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:2}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #htBalloonGrid{box-sizing:border-box;aspect-ratio:1/1!important;flex:0 0 auto;min-width:0;min-height:0;max-width:100%!important;max-height:100%!important;border:3px solid #efcf8a;padding:clamp(6px,.85vw,14px);gap:clamp(2px,.5vw,9px);background:rgba(7,31,48,.22)!important}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htBalloon{border:0!important;border-radius:0!important;background:transparent!important;box-shadow:none!important;overflow:visible!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 4px #04172488)}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htBalloon img{width:100%!important;height:100%!important;object-fit:contain!important;image-rendering:pixelated!important;filter:none!important}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htBalloonNumber{font:1000 clamp(21px,2.4vw,38px)/1 system-ui,'Noto Sans KR',sans-serif!important;color:#231720!important;text-shadow:0 1px #ffe2a0,1px 0 #ffe2a0!important;padding:0!important;transform:translateY(-3%);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htBalloon.solved{background:transparent!important}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htBalloon.solved img{opacity:.6!important;filter:grayscale(.55) brightness(.78)!important}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htBalloon.solved .htBalloonNumber{color:white!important;text-shadow:1px 2px #171118!important}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #htFxLayer{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:visible;z-index:20}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htScores{z-index:4;gap:clamp(6px,1vh,13px)}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamScore{min-height:clamp(58px,10%,108px);padding:clamp(7px,1vw,15px);overflow:visible!important;isolation:isolate;transform:none!important;transition:background .18s,color .18s}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamScore.active{background:#fffdf5!important;border-color:var(--team)!important;color:#151c23!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #fff,inset 0 0 0 7px var(--team),0 3px 0 #06131cb0,0 0 22px #fff7abbb!important}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamScore.active::before,#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamScore.active::after{display:none!important}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamScore.active .htTeamName{color:#151c23!important;text-shadow:none!important}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamScore.active .htTeamPts{color:#121820!important;text-shadow:none!important;font-weight:1000}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamScore .htTeamName,#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamScore .htTeamPts{position:relative;z-index:3}
/* Exact Project A concept: one localized ember travels the rounded card border. */
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamScore.active>.htFuseSpark{position:absolute;z-index:7;width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;offset-path:inset(4px round 12px);offset-distance:0%;offset-rotate:0deg;offset-anchor:50% 50%;background:#fff6a8;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #ffb000,0 0 6px 4px #ff6500,0 0 13px 7px rgba(255,40,0,.87);animation:htFuseRunR5 .85s linear infinite}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamScore.active>.htFuseSpark::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:-7px;top:3px;width:7px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:#ff6500;box-shadow:0 0 5px 3px rgba(255,70,0,.7);opacity:.8}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamScore.active>.htFuseSpark::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:2px;top:2px;width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:white;animation:htSparkFlickerR5 .12s steps(2,end) infinite}
@keyframes htFuseRunR5{from{offset-distance:0%}to{offset-distance:100%}}
@keyframes htSparkFlickerR5{0%,49%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}50%,100%{opacity:.42;transform:scale(.72)}}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamScore.scoreGain{animation:htScoreGain .98s cubic-bezier(.18,1.2,.28,1) !important}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamScore.scoreLoss{animation:htScoreLoss .98s cubic-bezier(.18,1.2,.28,1) !important}
/* R4 original show modal and sprite animation preserved; pipe buttons always clickable. */
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #htItemLayer{pointer-events:auto;z-index:60!important}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htPipeBtn{pointer-events:auto;position:relative;z-index:61;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htPipeBtn img{pointer-events:none}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htPipeBtn:focus-visible{outline:4px solid #ffde7e;outline-offset:4px}
@media(max-width:900px){#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #htTeamBoard{grid-template-columns:minmax(80px,1.1fr) minmax(0,4.7fr) minmax(80px,1.1fr)!important;gap:5px!important}#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamScore{min-height:45px;padding:5px!important}#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamName{font-size:11px!important}#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamPts{font-size:19px!important}#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htBalloonNumber{font-size:clamp(13px,3vw,24px)!important}}
</style>
